page.overview:
Who is Ishara Nawan?

Ishara Nawan was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year ., Ishara Nawan}}

Ishara's name could indicate Andoran origin (see Ishara Casalain).

Ishara held the position for thirty-five years until her death in . She was Nirelle Coidevwin's successor and Cerilla Marodred's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Ishara was a strong and influential Amyrlin. She continued the policies of her predecessors but in a modified way, because she involved directly the White Tower in fewer wars. She gained considerable influence but also entangled the Aes Sedai in several dangerous situations that came to a head only after her death.
